identity.description: Stored identity record with encrypted private key payload.

identity_id.description: Identity ID to look up public key (alternative to public_key)
The identity ID to set as primary

allow_unverified_legacy.description: Explicitly import a manifestless legacy bundle without completeness guarantees. Default false rejects bundles that predate authenticated completeness verification.

blinding_factor.description: Optional base64url blinding factor (auto-generated if omitted)
The blinding factor from the original commitment

withhold.description: Fields the agent MUST NOT disclose

proof_required.description: Fields that require proof rather than plain disclosure

default_action.description: What to do when no rule matches a field

identity_id.description: Optional identity this policy is bound to

policy_id.description: Specific policy to evaluate (uses first available if omitted)

value.description: The integer value to commit to

proof.description: The ZK proof object from zk_prove
The range proof object from zk_range_prove

counterparty_attestation.description: Counterparty's signed attestation of the same interaction

identity_id.description: Identity to sign with (uses default if omitted)
Identity to sign the bundle with

allow_unverified_legacy.description: Explicitly import a manifestless legacy reputation bundle without completeness guarantees. Default false rejects bundles that predate signed completeness verification.

metric.description: Which metric to compute the weighted score for

agent_identity_id.description: Identity of the agent being guaranteed

duration_seconds.description: How long the guarantee is valid

type.description: Type of data to publish: 'shr' for full sovereignty health report, 'handshake' for a handshake attestation, 'sovereignty-update' for layer-level updates.

verascore_agent_id.description: Agent ID on Verascore. If omitted, uses the default identity's DID-derived slug.

verascore_url.description: Verascore API base URL. Defaults to https://verascore.ai

data.description: The data payload. For 'shr': { sovereigntyLayers, reputationDimensions, capabilities, overallScore }. For 'handshake': { attestation: { id, responderId, ... } }. For 'sovereignty-update': { layers: [{ name, label, score, status, description }] }.

identity_id.description: Identity to sign with (uses default if omitted)
Identity to sign the SHR with. Defaults to primary identity.

validity_minutes.description: How long the SHR is valid (minutes). Default: 60.

shr.description: The signed SHR to verify (full SignedSHR object).

format.description: Output format: 'ping' (Ping Identity Gateway format) or 'generic' (format-agnostic). Default: 'ping'.

identity_id.description: Identity to sign the SHR with. Defaults to primary identity.

validity_minutes.description: How long the SHR is valid (minutes). Default: 60.

identity_id.description: Identity to use for the handshake. Defaults to primary identity.

challenge.description: The HandshakeChallenge received from the initiator.

identity_id.description: Identity to use for the response. Defaults to primary identity.

response.description: The HandshakeResponse received from the responder.

completion.description: Optional: HandshakeCompletion from the initiator (responder-side verification).

counterparty_shr.description: The counterparty's signed SHR (SignedSHR object with body, signed_by, signature).

identity_id.description: Identity to use for the exchange. Defaults to primary identity.

attestation.description: The SignedAttestation object to verify (body, signed_by, signature, summary).

session_id.description: Session ID returned from handshake_initiate / handshake_respond.

reason.description: Why the session is being aborted. Defaults to 'operator_cancelled'.

action.description: Operation to perform on the peer registry

peer_did.description: Peer DID. Optional: defaults to the did:key derived from the public key that signed the handshake SHR. If supplied, it MUST match that derived DID — a mismatched label is rejected.

active_only.description: When listing, only show peers with active handshakes

mutual_attestation_count.description: Number of mutual attestations with this peer (0 if unknown)

proposer_did.description: DID of the party who proposed the accepted terms

acceptor_did.description: DID of the party who accepted

terms.description: The accepted terms (opaque to Sanctuary, meaningful to Concordia)

terms_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical terms serialization (computed by Concordia)

accepted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when accept was issued

identity_id.description: Sanctuary identity to sign the commitment (uses default if omitted)

include_pedersen.description: Include a Pedersen commitment on round count for ZK range proofs

bridge_commitment_id.description: The bridge commitment ID to verify

committer_public_key.description: The committer's Ed25519 public key (base64url). Required if verifying a counterparty's commitment. Omit to auto-resolve from local identities.

outcome.description: Revealed ConcordiaOutcome to verify against the commitment. If omitted, the stored outcome is used for backward-compatible local checks.

bridge_commitment_id.description: The bridge commitment ID to link

identity_id.description: Identity to sign the attestation (uses default if omitted)

deep_scan.description: If true (default), also scans for OpenClaw config, .env files, and memory files. Set to false for a Sanctuary-only assessment.

format.description: Output format: "cef" (Common Event Format, newline-delimited) or "ocsf" (Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework, JSON array)

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Export only events on or after this time. Defaults to 24 hours ago.

until.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Export only events before this time. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to export (default 100, max 1000). Set to 1000 for bulk exports to SIEMs.

filter_tool.description: Optional. Export only events from this tool name (e.g., "sovereignty_audit", "state_set"). Case-insensitive substring matching.

filter_decision.description: Optional. Export only events with this gate decision: "approve" (manual approval), "deny" (blocked), or "auto-allow" (Tier 3 auto-allowed).

filter_layer.description: Optional. Export only events from this sovereignty layer (L1=Cognitive, L2=Operational, L3=Disclosure, L4=Reputation).

filter_result.description: Optional. Export only events with this result: "success" or "failure".

context.description: A sample context object to analyze. Each top-level key will be classified. Values are inspected for size warnings but not stored.

provider.description: Provider category to generate rules for. Default: 'inference'.

policy_id.description: ID of the context-gating policy to apply

provider.description: Provider category for this call: inference, tool-api, logging, analytics, peer-agent, or custom

context.description: The context object to filter. Each top-level key is evaluated against the policy. Example keys: task_description, conversation_history, user_preferences, api_keys, memory, internal_reasoning

enabled.description: Enable or disable the automatic enforcer. When disabled, no filtering occurs. Default: leave unchanged.

log_only.description: Enable log_only mode with a bound policy: filter decisions are logged but original args are passed to handlers. Useful for monitoring before enabling actual filtering. Default: leave unchanged.

default_policy_id.description: Set the default context-gating policy to use for filtering. If not set while the enforcer is enabled, calls are blocked. Default: leave unchanged.

on_deny.description: Action to take when a field triggers the deny action: 'block' returns an error and prevents the call, 'redact' replaces the denied field with [REDACTED] and continues. Default: leave unchanged.

reset_stats.description: Reset the enforcer statistics counters to zero. Default: false.

include_details.description: If true, include detailed check results for memory, process, and filesystem. If false, show summary only.

check_filesystem.description: If true, verify Sanctuary storage directory permissions.

check_memory.description: If true, verify memory protection mechanisms (ASLR, etc.).

check_process.description: If true, detect container, VM, or sandbox environment.

injection_detection.description: Toggle injection detection and set sensitivity

policy_id.description: ID of the context-gating policy to use

context_gating.description: Toggle context gating and set active policy

label.description: Human-readable label for the new identity (default: 'sovereign-agent')

verascore_url.description: Verascore base URL. Defaults to server config / SANCTUARY_VERASCORE_URL.

publish.description: Whether to publish the SHR to Verascore. Defaults to true.

identity_id.description: Identity to export (defaults to primary identity).

attestations.description: Optional list of attestation objects to include in the bundle.

email.description: Email address of the human to link this agent to.

verascore_url.description: Verascore base URL. Defaults to server config.

nonce.description: The nonce / challenge string to sign.

purpose.description: Domain-separation tag identifying what the signature will be used for (e.g. 'verascore-claim'). Required. Max 128 chars, printable ASCII only.

identity_id.description: Identity to sign with (defaults to primary).

operation.description: The memory operation that was performed: store, retrieve, update, delete, or search.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the memory content (hex or base64url). If you have raw content, hash it first — never pass raw memory content to this tool.

memory_id.description: Optional: ID returned by the memory provider for this memory entry.

user_id.description: Optional: user ID associated with this memory operation.

agent_id.description: Optional: agent ID that performed the operation.

session_id.description: Optional: session ID in which the operation occurred.

identity_id.description: Optional: Sanctuary identity to sign with. Defaults to primary identity.

taint.description: Provenance of the text: user_content (conversation-derived), agent_derived_clean (agent summary), or system_generated. This is a hint, not a secret-free guarantee: forbidden taints and secret-classifier hits are rejected before encryption.

passage_id.description: Optional caller-supplied id (SDW identifier grammar); generated if absent

tag.description: Optional: restrict to passages carrying this tag

after.description: Optional cursor: return ids strictly after this one

passage_id.description: Passage id to inspect provenance for

description.description: Free-text description of what the agent does — its intended purpose, the users it serves, the decisions it makes, the data it processes.

agent_did.description: DID of the agent the bundle is being generated for.

deployment_context.description: Enterprise-supplied deployment facts that Sanctuary cannot infer (vertical, intended purpose, provider legal name, Annex III classification, etc.).

period_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — start of the reporting period.

period_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — end of the reporting period.

delta_from_bundle_path.description: Optional filesystem path to a prior bundle directory. When supplied, the generator compares the current bundle to the prior one and emits an additional 08_delta.md document summarising what changed (regulation_version, matrix_version, coverage rows added/removed/changed). Delta problems never fail bundle generation; the bundle always lands locally.

publish_to_verascore.description: If true, POST the signed bundle MANIFEST (not the document bodies) to Verascore after the bundle is generated. Non-dependency principle: publish failure never fails bundle generation — the bundle is returned with a publish_result field describing the outcome. Defaults to false.

verascore_url.description: Optional Verascore base URL (HTTPS, allow-listed hosts only). Defaults to https://verascore.ai.

registry_address.description: EIP-55 checksummed Ethereum address of the Identity Registry contract.

nonce.description: Anti-replay nonce from the registry contract.

metadata_uri.description: Optional IPFS or HTTPS URI for off-chain agent metadata.

counterparty.description: Optional counterparty agent id for policy-gate matching.

request_id.description: If provided, check the status of an existing request instead of creating a new one (poll pattern).

detail.description: Optional short plain-text context (control characters stripped).

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the reset. This clears all governor state including the lifetime counter.
